customer_segment: Individuals and teams (including SMBs and enterprise teams) seeking a digital workspace to manage notes, knowledge, and project/workflow collaboration (E3, E6, E7, E8, E10)
end_activity: Operate day-to-day knowledge work and project execution from an organized, shared digital workspace (E3, E10)

activities.activity: Recognize a need to centralize notes, knowledge, and project/work tracking in a more coherent system
activities.customer_goal: Clarify the job-to-be-done (personal productivity or team coordination) and what “one workspace” must cover (notes, knowledge, projects, collaboration)

activities.activity: Search for and evaluate workspace options (all-in-one vs. multiple tools) and decide what to adopt
activities.current_provider: a mix of software options and internal/ad-hoc practices
activities.customer_goal: Select an approach that can handle note-taking, knowledge organization, project/workflow management, and collaboration with acceptable switching effort

activities.activity: Create an account and set up the workspace (initial structure for notes/knowledge/projects; invite collaborators if needed)
activities.customer_goal: Get to a usable starting point quickly (a functional workspace that matches the user’s/team’s way of working)

activities.activity: Capture and maintain content in the workspace (notes, documents, tasks, project updates, and reference knowledge)
activities.current_provider: Notion or a mix of other tools/manual documentation
activities.customer_goal: Make the workspace the default place where work artifacts and updates live, rather than scattered across systems

activities.activity: Organize and connect information into reusable structures (knowledge base organization and project/workflow systemization)
activities.customer_goal: Turn raw notes and work items into an organized, navigable system that supports ongoing execution and knowledge reuse

activities.activity: Collaborate continuously (share, coordinate, and keep work/knowledge current as a team over time)
activities.customer_goal: Enable sustained team collaboration and execution in a shared workspace without losing alignment or institutional knowledge
